reviews.comment:
I recently had the pleasure of passing my practical driving test on my first attempt, thanks to the outstanding guidance of Nadeem and Prime Skills. From start to finish, my experience with him was nothing short of excellent, and I highly recommend his services to anyone looking to become a confident and skilled driver. As a university student, I was stressing that I have not practised enough for my test, but I was reassured by Prime Skills and was given the confidence I needed for my test. What sets Nadeem apart is his ability to provide personalized criticism and advice tailored to me. Despite considering myself a confident driver, Nadeem identified areas for refinement that I hadn't previously noticed. His insights were not just the same old common advice but rather fresh perspectives that truly opened my eyes to new ways of approaching driving. One notable example is when Nadeem identified that my observations were lacking during driving. Instead of simply pointing out the issue, he took the time to run me through specific exercises and breakdown techniques to improve my observation skills. I would say that I would have not passed the test without this.
Nadeem was overall an amazing instructor and an amazing friend. I would highly recommend him to all learner drivers!!

reviews.comment: I am a University student and I really wanted to pass my practical driving test before I went back to university for final year. I was recommended prime skills driving school and decided to contact them for lessons and was taken in for learning very quick! My past experience with other instructors has not been great which delayed my learning ability. However, prime skills has been excellent in the way they teach and encourage students. They made learning seem so fun and easy. I have never had driving lessons where time flies by so quick like I have with Prime Skills driving school. I received a 10 day intensive driving course offered by Prime Skills and it was one of the best decisions I have made. This was taken 10 days before my manual test and I have passed first time! Each lesson was packed with so much learning and practice and I loved every lesson! For someone who was always nervous about driving tests, I went into my test feeling confident and ready! Nadeem was a very good instructor, very friendly and chill but gave really good advice and clear instructions. He explained concepts really well with lots of patience and truly made the lessons very fun and informative! Overall, a very reassuring and friendly instructor with great teaching! I have learnt so much with Prime Skills Driving School and will carry on recommending others to learn from them! :)
